en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a lakeside scene labeled 'Bad Elster. Partie am Luisa-See.' It shows a small lake with people boating; in the foreground a man rows a wooden boat while a seated woman holds an umbrella. On the far shore are trees, a pavilion or lakeside café with a rustic pergola, moored boats, and tall flagpoles with long banners. In the background a church steeple rises above the tree line. The card has printed German text at the top.
